hero.subheadline: Russell Shea rebuilds bathrooms from the studs out, tiles tub surrounds, hangs kitchen cabinets and handles the excavation work too.

image.alt: Tub surround by a bathroom remodeler in Sharpsville: large white marble-look tile, corner shelves, grab bar and new tub

paragraphs: RS Construction Solutions is a bathroom remodeler in Sharpsville run by owner Russell Shea. He takes a bathroom down to the studs, replaces the tub, wallboard, tile and plumbing, and checks with you on alignment and placement as the walls go up.

Customers keep using the same words about him: prompt, organized, clean and careful. Google tags nine reviews for promptness. One homeowner with an old house and uneven floors had a full set of kitchen cabinets hung perfectly level. Another said Russell kept chasing a faulty shower cartridge from the manufacturer until it was fixed. Outside, the same company handles drainage, grading and shed pads.

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Full bathroom remodels that include demolition, new tub, backer board, tile and plumbing. Glenn's bathroom went from bare studs to a marble-look tile surround with corner shelves and a grab bar, with Russell checking alignment with him at each stage.

image.alt: Finished tub surround in large white marble-look tile with three corner shelves and a stainless grab bar

items.name: Tile tub and shower surrounds
items.blurb: Customers call Russell an expert tiler. He sets large-format wall tile with leveling clips over cement backer board, adds corner shelves where you want them, and keeps the mess contained while he works in your home.

image.alt: Tub surround in gray and beige wood-look plank tile with corner shelves

items.name: Shower rebuilds after water damage
items.blurb: In an August 2026 job, a Sharpsville customer called RS Construction to tear out a shower after finding water damage. Once the old shower was out, they decided to use the chance to give the space a full update.

image.alt: Large marble-look wall tile being set with blue leveling clips around a tub and window

items.name: Kitchen remodeling and cabinet installation
items.blurb: Kitchen remodels and cabinet installs, including custom layouts in older homes. In one house with uneven walls and floors, Russell arrived with every material he needed and hung the cabinets perfectly level. Countertops and flooring are also on his list.

image.alt: Kitchen with dark cherry cabinets, angled island with cooktop and beadboard sides, glass pendant lights and white subway tile backsplash

items.title: He checks with you as he goes
items.text: Glenn wrote that Russell regularly checked with them on alignment and positioning during the remodel, making sure they got exactly what they wanted.

items.title: Prompt and organized
items.text: Google tags nine reviews for promptness. Jasmine describes Russell as organized and prompt, and quick to come back for anything that needed more attention.

items.title: Level work in old houses
items.text: Monica's old house had uneven walls and floors, yet Russell's cabinet install ended up perfectly level. He came prepared with every material and supply he needed.

items.title: Follow-through after the job
items.text: When a shower cartridge turned out to be defective from the manufacturer, Russell worked to get it resolved quickly. Customers call that kind of follow-through hard to find.

about.text: RS Construction Solutions LLC is Russell Shea's company, based on Saranac Drive in Sharpsville. Russell handles the work himself, which is why every review names him. His jobs range from bathroom and kitchen remodels to excavation, French drains, grading and shed pads, so one call covers both the inside and the outside of the house. Customers describe him as a skilled craftsman with a great attitude who keeps the work area clean. He is willing to travel for the right project, as he did for one cabinet job in Akron, Ohio.

image.alt: No photo of Russell on file

steps.title: Call Russell
steps.text: Call (724) 456-3396 or email russell99shea@gmail.com to describe the room, any water damage you have found and what you want changed.

steps.title: Tear out
steps.text: Russell removes the old tub, tile and wallboard, opening the wall to the studs so any damage behind it can be dealt with.

steps.title: Rebuild the base
steps.text: New plumbing and cement backer board go in, giving the tile a solid, water-ready surface instead of tiling over old problems.

steps.title: Tile and fixtures
steps.text: Tile goes up with leveling clips, shelves and grab bars are placed, and Russell checks alignment and positioning with you along the way.

steps.title: Follow up
steps.text: Once you are using the room, Russell follows up on anything that needs more attention until you are fully satisfied.

items.name: Glenn W.
items.text:
Russell with RS Construction Solution is the best contractor I have ever hired. He remodeled our bathroom, replacing the tub, wallboards, tile, and plumbing, and the quality of his work was outstanding. Throughout the entire project, he was committed to making sure we got exactly what we wanted. He paid close attention to every detail, kept things clean, and regularly checked with us on things like alignment and positioning, which really showed how much he cares about doing the job right. His craftsmanship is exceptional, and his dedication to his work is clear in every part of the project.

He made sure when the cartridge in our shower handle turned out to be defective from the manufacturer, Russell went above and beyond to help resolve the issue as quickly as possible. He is a exceptional craftsman and person. That level of professionalism and follow-through is hard to find.

I cannot recommend Russell and RS Construction Solution highly enough.

items.name: Monica M.
items.text: We have an old house with uneven walls and floors, but Russell handled our custom cabinet layout with zero issues. He worked fast and was focused while here and had a great attitude the whole time. His attention to detail was awesome and everything ended up perfectly level despite our old house. Russell came prepared with all the materials and supplies he need to do the hanging and installation of our cabinetsand. The quality of the work is excellent and we would definitely hire him to do more work in the future!

items.name: Jasmine M.
items.text: Russell at RS Construction is an expert tiler & beyond. He is organized, prompt, detailed to keep mess contained and finish a job to look precise, clean and done with quality care. He was quick to follow up promptly for anything that needed further attention to be sure we were fully satisfied. I would highly recommend him for a bathroom remodel & more.

service_area.text: RS Construction Solutions works out of 3871 Saranac Dr in Sharpsville, PA, and its posted bathroom, drainage and shed pad projects are in Sharpsville. Russell has also travelled for the right job, hanging a full set of kitchen cabinets for a customer in Akron, Ohio. If you are not sure whether your home is in range, call with your address and project.

items.q: What kind of bathroom work do you do?
items.a: Full remodels as well as smaller updates. Past jobs include replacing a tub, wallboard, tile and plumbing, tearing out a water-damaged shower, tiling tub surrounds with corner shelves and grab bars, and installing a new vanity. Call to talk through what your bathroom needs.

Yes. Kitchen remodeling, countertops, flooring and cabinet installation are all part of the work. In one older home with uneven walls and floors, Russell hung a custom cabinet layout that ended up perfectly level. Call (724) 456-3396 to describe your kitchen.

items.q: What excavation work do you offer?
items.a: Drainage solutions, French drains, land clearing, water lines, grading, driveway work and shed pads. Reviews also mention above ground pool removal, yard leveling and fill. One recent Sharpsville project regraded a backyard so water would drain away from the house.

Google lists RS Construction Solutions as open 24 hours, seven days a week. The easiest way to reach Russell is by phone at (724) 456-3396. You can also email russell99shea@gmail.com with photos of the room or yard and a short description.

The business is at 3871 Saranac Dr, Sharpsville, PA 16150, and most posted projects are in Sharpsville. Russell has also taken work as far away as Akron, Ohio. Call with your address and he will tell you whether your project fits his schedule.
